card.name: Word before a fixed follow-on phrase
card.fires_on: Responds to a word whose next words are almost certain, such as 'activities' before 'requiring mental alertness' and 'creat-ine' before 'phosphokinase' or 'kinase'. Also fires on 'can' in 'can be found at'.
